title: Can Large Language Models Simulate Human Responses? A Case Study of Stated Preference Experiments in the Context of Heating-related Choices

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the aggregated choice distributions of LLM-simulated responses against actual human survey data using chi-square goodness-of-fit tests and Jensen-Shannon distance, specifically observing a systematic over-selection of eco-friendly and energy-efficient options.

Stratifying simulation accuracy (Accuracy and F1 scores) across different demographic sub-groups, such as households with or without seniors, households with or without children, and different income levels, to assess performance variations.
